preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 5 and 200,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.
The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and uj != vj and 1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and xj != yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case must specify valid cities for JH and JY within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of times for each test case.
If JH and JY never meet at the same city, the output must include -1.
If JH and JY meet at the beginning of their run, the output must include 0.
